text:
Maya: quick sync — proposing a new approach for DP recruitment: an "hourglass" onboarding with a 2-week commitment window for pilots, then wider waves. aim: sharper feedback early, lower churn later. thoughts?
Sam: like it. want more detail on how we gate from pilot -> wave A. acceptance matrix?
Maya: gate = product + ops checks: stability (error rate < 1%), integration (rt < 400ms 95p), and engagement (weekly active flows >= 3). also qualitative check from AE.
Alex: can we make the acceptance matrix machine-readable for tracking? i sketched something: ```pilot: 5 partners; stability: <1% errors; perf: 95p < 400ms; commit: 2-week pilot window; waveA: 20 partners; perf: 95p < 350ms; engagement: 2 active product paths; rollout: staged 2 weeks```
Priya: +1 on the machine-readable matrix. also recommend micro-incentives (credits + visibility call) to reduce dropouts during the 2-week window.
Owen: ops question — how do we handle rollbacks if partner sees regressions? need automatic fallback policy and runbook.
Maya: good catch. plan: every partner gets a canary flag. if regression > threshold, automated fallback to last stable model + @oncall ping. runbook link: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/dp-fallback (placeholder)
Sam: feedback loop — propose a dual stream: 1) weekly 30m check-ins + 2) in-app micro-surveys after key flows. telemetry: capture prefix latency, token counts, and top-3 failure messages.
Alex: agree. add prompt-set pegging: each partner supplies 10 canonical prompts we run blind evals on every rollout. if quality delta > 3 points (chosen metric), block rollout.
Priya: metrics to report for success: retention at 30 days, average session depth, qualitative NPS from partners, and number of regressions caught pre-launch.
Owen: timeline idea — Week 0: pilot invites (5); Week 2: pilot review + adjustments; Week 4: wave A invites (20); Week 8: wave B (scale). can we compress? depends on engineering capacity.
Maya: decision needed: do we require an NDA for pilot partners? advantages: open feedback. downside: friction. leaning no for early pilot, yes for waveA+.
Sam: +1 to no NDA for pilot. ask for a light TOS and feedback consent.
Alex: action items:
- Maya: finalize hourglass playbook and acceptance matrix (due EOD Thu)
- Priya: draft micro-incentive package and survey templates (due Mon)
- Owen: scope fallback automation and oncall flow (draft runbook by Fri)
- Sam: create calendar slots for weekly check-ins and invite list draft (by Tue)
Maya: sounds good. tagging @deploy-bot to create a recurring calendar + invite template. :
deploy-bot: created event series "DP Weekly Check-in (30m)" and shared with Maya, Sam, Priya, Alex, Owen. :calendar:
Sam: one more Q — acceptance signals from customers vs internal signals: prioritize customer qualitative signals for product decisions, but keep release gating tied to internal stability/perf metrics.
Maya: agreed. final note: experiment with 2-week commitment window wording in outreach — call it "early-commitment period" and offer a migration checklist so partners know expectations.
Priya: I can draft outreach copy later today. will include clear expectations and sample success stories.
Owen: ok to close this thread after Maya posts the finalized matrix. thanks team. :thumbsup:
